name: Status Dot
description: A small colored dot with an optional text label for compact entity status.

anatomy.description: Small colored marker with variant and size options; aria-hidden.
Optional visible text that carries the status meaning.

dos: Pair the dot with a text label so color is never the only signal.
Use the success, warning, and danger variants for health-style readouts.
donts: Don't use a bare dot for a status users must act on; use Alert or Banner.
Don't animate it for live activity; use PulseDot instead.

examples.title: Labeled statuses
examples.description: Dots paired with text labels for scanable inline status in lists and headers.

examples.title: Semantic variants
examples.description: The success, warning, and danger variants for health-style readouts.

guidance.useWhen: You need a compact, glanceable status marker next to an entity name, for example in tables or list rows.
guidance.avoidWhen: The status needs more explanation or an action; use Alert or Banner instead.
guidance.behavior: Purely presentational: the dot is hidden from assistive technology and the visible label carries the meaning.
guidance.responsive: Stays inline and shrinks to content; the label truncates with the surrounding layout.

notes: The colored dot is aria-hidden; always pair it with a text label or an aria-label so color is not the only signal.
Color alone never conveys the status — the label text does.

props.description: Optional text rendered next to the dot.
props.name: label
